name: deepface
description: Face detection/analysis/embedding and matching features inspired by serengil/deepface.

features.name: detect
features.description: Skin-color heuristic proxy: emits face_count as a skin_region_proxy (any warm/skin-toned region counts as 1, greyscale or atypical-tone faces as 0). Not a real face detector; prone to false positives on warm non-face regions and false negatives on atypical skin tones.

features.name: analyze
features.description: Returns measured image/region pixel statistics (mean luma, luma std, contrast, exposure, noise, skin ratio, eye-open proxy, face confidence). Does NOT predict age, gender, or emotion.

features.name: represent
features.description: Returns deterministic face embeddings and embedding ids.

features.name: verify
features.description: Pairwise verification across selected images using deterministic proxy distances.

features.name: find
features.description: Search-like retrieval for each image against the set, returns nearest candidates.

features.name: register
features.description: Index-builder for faces represented in a local image set.
